record.question: Which pneumococcal vaccination strategy is recommended in CKD?
record.explanation: Answer C: PCV13 followed by PPSV23. Indian adult pneumococcal consensus guidance for immunocompromised adults including CKD recommends a PCV13 dose followed by PPSV23 (with interval depending on immune-risk category). Reference: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7703813/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11302778/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
